verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents a hosted customer portal where customers manage their account. A Stripe PM also mentions credit-card update notice emails, which loosely covers the hosted update-payment-page part of the story. The evidence never says the portal handles payment-method updates, and nothing describes automatic card updating. Missing for 10: network account updater / automatic card refresh, backup or fallback payment methods, explicit documentation that the hosted portal or page updates payment methods, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages

citations.quote: Give your customers the ability to manage their account by setting up a customer portal.
Stripe Billing PM stated all customer emails (like credit card update notices) are off by default
